-- “sasaraM nirjalaM GolaM maTitaM tvasarodakam । takraM pAdajalaM proktamudaSvidardDavArikam ॥ CacCikA sarahInaM syAdacCA pracuravArikA ॥” tezAM guRAH । “vAtapittaharaM GolaM maTitaM kaPapittanut । takraM grAhi kazAyAmlaM svAdupAkarasaM laGu ॥ vIryyozRaM dIpanaM vfzyaM prIRanaM vAtanASanam । grahaRyAdimatAM paTyaM Bavet saMgrAhi lAGavAt ॥ kiYca svAdu vipAkitvAnna ca pittaprakopaRam । kazAyozRavikASitvAdrOkzyAccApi kaPApaham ॥ na takrasevI vyaTate kadAcinna takradagDAH praBavanti rogAH । yaTA surARAmamftaM suKAya taTA narARAM Buvi takramAhuH ॥ udaSvit kaPakfdbalyaM SramaGnaM paramaM matam । CacCikA SItalA laGvI pittaSramatfzAharI ॥ vAtanut kaPakft sA tu dIpanI lavaRAnvitA ॥” aTodDftaGftastokodDftaGftAnudDftaGftAnAM takrARAM guRAH । “samudDftaM GftaM takraM paTyaM laGu viSezataH । stokodDftaGftaM tasmAdguru vfzyaM kaPApaham ॥ anudDftaGftaM sAndraM guru puzwikaPapradam ॥” * ॥ aTa dozaviSeze vyADiviSeze ca takraviSezAH । “vAte'mlaM Sasyate takraM SuRWIsEnDavasaMyutam । pitte svAdusitAyuktaM savyozamavfzaM kaPe ॥ hiNgujIrayutaM GolaM sEnDavena susaMyutam । BavedatIva vAtaGnamarSo'tIsArahft param ॥ surucyaM puzwidaM balyaM vastiSUlavinASanam । mUtrakfcCre tu saguqaM pARquroge sacitrakam ॥” * ॥ aTAmapakvatakraguRAH । “takramAmaM kaPaM kozWe hanti kaRWe karoti ca । pInasaSvAsakAsAdO pakvameva prayujyate ॥” * ॥ aTa takrasevananimittAni । “SItakAle'gnimAndye ca taTA vAtAmayezu ca । arucO srotasAM roDe takraM syAdamftopamam ॥ tattu hanti garacCarddiprasekavizamajvarAn । pARqumedograhaRyarSomUtragrahaBagandarAn ॥ mehaM gulmamatIsAraM SUlaplIhodarArucIH । SvitrakoWaDftavyADIn kuzWaSoTatfzAkfmIn ॥” aTAtakravizayAH । “nEva takraM kzate dadyAnnozRakAle na durbbale । na mUrcCABramadAhezu na roge raktapEttike ॥” * ॥ aTa gavyAdInAM takrARAM viSizwaguRAH । “yAnyuktAni daDInyazwO tadguRaM takramAdiSet ॥” iti BAvaprakASaH ॥ (“gavyantridozaSamanaM takraM SrezWantaducyate । dIpanaM rucikfnmeDyamarSodaravikArajit ॥” iti gavyatakraguRAH ॥ “mAhizaM kaPakft kiYcidGanaM SoPakaraM nfRAm । plIhArSograhaRIgulmapARqvAmayavinASanam ॥” iti mAhizatakraguRAH ॥ “CAgalaM laGu saMsnigDaM tridozaSamanaM param । gulmASagrihaRISUlaM pARqvAmayavinASanam ॥” iti CAgItakraguRAH ॥ “taTAca triviDaM takraM kaTyate SfRu puttraka ! । yaTAyogena tat samyak Sasyate yezu rogizu ॥ samudDataGftaM takramardDodDftaGftaYca tat । anudDftaGftaYcAnyadityetattriviDaM matam ॥ sarvvaM laGu ca paTyaYca tridozaSamanaM param । tataH paraM vfzyatamaM krameRa samudIritam । samudDftaGftantakraM laGu paTyatamaM matam ॥ garodarArSograhaRIpARqurogajvarAture । varccomUtragrahe vApi plIhAvyApadamehizu ॥ hitaM saMprIRanaM balyaM pittaraktaviboDakft ॥ ardDodDftaGftaM tasmAdvfzyaM guru kaPapradam । maDuraM pittaraktaGnaM SramaGnaM paramaM matam ॥ anudDftaGftaM sAndraM guru vidyAt kaPAvaham । balapradantu kzIRAnAmAmaSoPAtisArakft ॥” iti triviDatakraguRAH ॥ * ॥ “takraM grAhi kazAyAmlaM vIryyozRaM dIpanaM laGu । SramApaharaRaM snigDaM grahaRyarSo'tisAranut ॥ iti takraguRAH proktA praTamasTAne'zwame'DyAye ॥ * ॥)

puzwikaPapradam” ya dozaviSeze vyADiviSeze takraviSezAH । vAte'mle Sasyate takraM SuRWIsEnDavasaMyutam । pitte svAdusitAyuktaM savyozamaDike kaPe । hiNgujIrayutaM GolaM sEnDavena ca saMyutam । BavedatIva vAtaGnamarSo'tIsArahftparam । rucidaM puzwidaM balyaM vastiSUlavinASanam । mUtrakfcCre tu saguqaM pARquroge sacitrakam” । aTAmapakkatakraguRAH “takramAmaM kaPaM kozWe hanti kaRWe karoti ca (8 times), &c., once तक्षुर्, ii, 19, 8; 2. du. तक्षथुर्, x, 39, 4; pr. p. f. तक्षती, i, 164, 41; pf. Pass. p. तष्ट See s.v.) to form by cutting, plane, chisel, chop, RV. &c.; to cut, split, MBh.; Hariv.; Hcar.; to fashion, form (out of wood &c.), make, create, RV.; AV.; to form in the mind, invent, RV.; to make (any one young; double acc.), make able or prepare for (dat.), RV.; (in math.) to reduce by dividing, Gol. xiii, 14 ff.; Līl. &c.; = √ त्वच्, Dhātup. xvii, 13; to, skin, ib. : Caus. तक्षयति (aor. अततक्षत्), Pāṇ. vii, 4, 93, Kāś.; cf. त्वक्ष्.
2. तक्ष् ‘paring’, See काष्ठ-.
a: तक्ष् — {c1c} {c5c} P. (तक्षति, तक्ष्णोति, तष्ट) 1 To chop, cut off, pare, chisel, slice, split; आत्मानं तक्षति ह्येष वनं परशुना यथा Mb.; निधाय तक्ष्यते यत्र काष्ठे काष्ठं स उद्घनः Ak. --2 To fashion, shape, form (out of wood &c.). --3 To make, create in general. --4 To wound, hurt. --5 To invent, form in the mind. --6 To make one's own, appropriate. --7 To cover. --8 To peel. --9 To make thin. --WITH निस् 1 to slice out of. --2 to form, create.
तक्ष् — a. (At the end of comp.) Paring, cutting &c.; also तक्ष.

a: तक्षकः — [तक्ष् ण्वुल्] 1 A carpenter, wood-cutter (whether by caste or profession). --2 The chief actor in the prelude of a drama (i. e. the सूत्रधार). --3 N. of the architect of the gods. --4 N. of one of the principal Nāgas or serpents of the Pātāla, son of Kaśyapa and Kadru; (saved at the intercession of the sage Āstīka from being burnt down in the serpent-sacrifice performed by king Janamejaya, in which many others of his race were burnt down to ashes).
